thesis: The page is the floor plan of a San Jose Eichler, drawn around its open atrium: you walk it room by room, and every tall thing in every room gets strapped to the beam as you pass.

signature.name: Atrium Plan + Strap Tick
signature.summary: A line-drawn mid-century floor plan around an open atrium is the nav and the hero drawing; a fixed mini-plan lights the room you are in; a mustard L-bracket strap tick marks every anchored tall piece in the hero plan, room headers, the lean-and-strap anchoring story, review cards pinned to rooms, tool outputs and the footer title block.

palette.family: Eichler Redwood + Olive Grove + Sun-Faded Mustard

layoutMoves: sections as rooms on one floor plan, with an atrium band in the middle of the page
3:12 Eichler gable seam as the hero diagonal and as the top edge of the color bands
fixed corner mini-plan locator at >=1024px, inline room tags on phones

motion.intro: roofline strokes left to right, photo unclips under the gable, strap ticks drop onto the plan's tall pieces (<=1.1s, h1 readable from frame 0)
stories: strap: pinned elevation where a bookcase leans 6deg, a strap draws and snaps it upright, then dresser, then TV, counter 1-3 anchored
light: corner mini-plan fills the current room in redwood as sections enter
motion.hover: a strap tick slides in at the item's left edge, 200ms
